name: Closed Rooted Orientation
statement: A finite connected graph is a learning-space graph exactly when it is a partial cube whose associated medium admits a rooted orientation in which every two outgoing edges at a vertex lie in a common square.
hypotheses: Finite connected graph; the orientation chooses one direction in every $\Theta$-class and has a root from which all straight messages are positive.
comments: Closedness without rootedness does not suffice.
